tasks.title: Implement the approved sync-aware restart-safe inbox coordination protocol
tasks.description: Replace the v1 best-effort inbox lock with a file-native v2 leased run protocol covering stable run IDs, processor-plus-host ownership, heartbeats, checkpoints, deterministic receipts, explicit stale and missing-lock recovery, conflict-aware audit, receipt-based metric idempotency, legacy compatibility, and documentation/tests.
acceptance_criteria: A v2 active lease records run identity, ownership, lease timestamps, lock version, claimed paths, processed paths, and unresolved paths.
Only one active v2 run exists per workspace; same-owner retries are idempotent and foreign claims fail safely.
Heartbeat, checkpoint, and normal completion require an exact active owned run and reject stale, malformed, changed, or ambiguous state.
Restarted owners can resume unresolved paths without reprocessing checkpointed paths, and terminal receipts preserve unresolved paths.
Stale and missing-lock recovery require explicit reasoned overrides with retained audit evidence and legacy-lock migration only through recovery.
Completion and metrics retries use the run/receipt identity, produce one canonical receipt, and never double-count.
Audit and mutations detect conflict copies, duplicate or divergent records, malformed metadata, split-brain paths, and incomplete overrides without choosing a winner.
Source paths are canonical, workspace-contained, and symlink-safe; coordination never deletes, moves, or copies source content as a conflict shortcut.
Documentation, scaffold guidance, focused fixtures, npm validation, and independent BWH review cover the approved contract.
